column1: # License texts every bundled Homebrew formula must ship, copied from the formula's pinned upstream source
# tarball (brew fetch --build-from-source; sha256 checked against the formula) into LICENSES/<formula>/.
# collect-licenses.sh copies them and verify-bundle-licenses.sh fails the bundle if any is missing or empty.
# A formula that ends up in the bundle (bin/ or a collected lib/ dependency) but is not listed here fails the build.
# <formula><TAB><files at the top level of the source tree, space separated><TAB><notices, optional>
#   notice = <file in the source tree>:<name>: the file's leading comment block, verbatim, saved as LICENSES/<formula>/<name>
#            (for code compiled in under a license of its own that the top-level files do not carry)
# binutils (bin/ar, lib/libbfd-*.dylib, lib/libsframe.*.dylib): ar, libbfd and libsframe are GPL-3.0-or-later
# (COPYING3); COPYING3.LIB (LGPLv3), COPYING (GPLv2) and COPYING.LIB (LGPLv2) cover the parts of the tree under
# those licenses (e.g. libiberty). Homebrew does not install COPYING3 / COPYING3.LIB into the keg, so all of them
# are taken from the source tarball.
# zstd (lib/libzstd.1.dylib): BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only, plus MIT for libdivsufsort-lite (lib/dictBuilder,
# compiled into libzstd for the ZDICT_* dictionary builder)
